policies.title: Dickinson College Remote Work Policy
policies.description: Establishes expectations and guidelines for remote and hybrid work arrangements, equipment provisions, eligibility criteria, and workplace safety requirements.

policies.title: Dickinson College Sick-Leave Bank Policy
policies.description: Details the paid sick leave bank for eligible full-time nonexempt employees, covering donation rules, college matching, draw eligibility, and maximum withdrawal caps.

policies.title: Dickinson College Vacation Policy
policies.description: Defines vacation accruals, allotments for exempt and nonexempt employees, fiscal year usage guidelines, rollover rules, and separation payouts.
